lines.text: The Liberalio body falls.
With its sheer size, it causes tremors as it slams into the ground, stirring up a cloud of dust.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: It fell!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Die!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Hrngh...!
A transformed Behemoth, Leviathan, and Ziz run toward the fallen body.
They pound on it with the hooves of a bull, bite it with the jaws of a crocodile, and stab it with the feathers of a bird.
The collapsed body begins firing streams of water from everywhere it can, as if in protest.
At the same time, the two Liberalio bodies that are still floating in the air lower themselves and shoot streams of water too.
The Four Beasts allow themselves to be bathed in water as they attack the fallen body.
*Boom! Thunk! Snap! Pow!*

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Don't stop! Keep attacking!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Aaaaargh...!
Behemoth rams into the body with her horns.
*Crunch! Crack!*
The Liberalio body starts to crack on the surface.
It shoots out more water in an attempt to strike back. Behemoth continues charging, all the while getting hit by the streams.
The other two floating bodies focus their attacks on Behemoth too.
Ziz spreads her wings to block them, and Leviathan pushes Behemoth's back.
*Crack!*
Behemoth pierces through the body.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Levi!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Hrngh...!
Leviathan spins and attacks with her tail.
She hits the crack made by Behemoth, splitting the body in two.
The core is revealed, and Behemoth chomps down on it.
It breaks with a loud crack.
With its core destroyed, the body scatters and disappears.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: We got one!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Just one...

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: I-I can't take it any longer...!
Ziz, who had been holding back the other bodies' attacks with her wings, gets slammed to the ground.
With their shield now gone, Behemoth and Leviathan are exposed to the streams of water.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Argh...!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I don't think... we'll be able to withstand this for very long...!
The two are unable to move because of the water pounding their backs.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Is it your plan to be pushed below ground?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Look...! If you're not going to help us, then shut up...!

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: In that case, I, in my great wisdom, shall help you.
An enormous black column shoots up under Bahamut's feet.
It pushes back the stream of water pouring down,
but soon, it's the pillar being pushed down.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Hmm. That is no good.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Ugh, you're just...!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: I-I can't move...!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Undo your transformation and get out of there.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Wh-what...?!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: I said, reduce the surface area where you can be hit and then get away. Why are you just standing there taking it?
After hearing the voice coming from somewhere, the three of them undo their transformations at once.
The streams of water lose their targets and churn against the ground.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Vesti. Smoke grenade.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: O-okay.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Emma, help with the disruption.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: You got it.
Leviathan suddenly smells a sweet aroma coming from nearby.
A missile comes flying from somewhere.
*Boom!*
The missile explodes, spreading acrid smoke. The whole area is covered in it.
Having lost their targets, the Liberalio bodies halt their attacks.
The Four Beasts look around nervously.
Just then, something covers their heads.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Eek...!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Gah...!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Shh, quiet. Stay low and follow me.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: You...!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: I said be quiet. Do you think camouflage can cover your voices?

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... Just be quiet. Please.
Covered by Eunhwa's camouflage scarf, the Four Beasts move together with Eunhwa to the area covered in smoke.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Th-they're not attacking...

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: We'll be all right for a little while. There's a high concentration of Alva Particles mixed in with that smoke grenade.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: It completely disrupts their sensors, so they won't be able to detect us.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Still, it's dangerous to stay here too long. Let's go.
Soon, they arrive at a low hill covered in boulders.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Here. This is a blind spot in their sensors.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Take a break.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: ... You. Why're you here?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Why do you think? We're here to help.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Um... Who is she...?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I fought her with Levi before. We lost.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Y-you lost...?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Well... We only really won because of Rapi.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Where are the other two?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Guys.
Vesti's and Emma's faces appear out of nowhere.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Eek...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: H-hi...

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Hey, there. It's been a while, huh?
Eunhwa hides behind a boulder and peeks her head out.
The two Liberalio bodies are looking around, searching for their targets.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... You managed to take one of those things down.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Don't get me started. We almost died.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: I know. I saw.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: It looked like mud wrestling.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... Excuse me?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: You just overwhelmed it by sheer force...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: The enemy clearly has the upper hand when it comes to sheer specs.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: If you fight like that again, you'll likely get wiped out.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Y-you're all out of energy, while those two things are still untouched.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Why don't you just get lost? We agreed to work with Young Man, not with any of you.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: If you're here to help, then shut your mouths and help. No one asked for your advice from the sidelines.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: How are you guys planning to help us anyway?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Did you bring some kind of giant weapon? I don't see one.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: If those tiny weapons in your hand are all you have, then just leave. You'll only get in our way.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It sounds like all you did was watch as we took one of those things down, so how exactly are you helping?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: ... That's not really how you should talk to people who are here to help.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Wh-what did you say?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Now, now. Let's not fight.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: The reason we didn't join you earlier is because we wanted to see how both you and those things fight.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: We needed to see what weapons everyone had and try to guess at your specs.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: See how we're able to have a little meeting here, safe and sound?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: It's because we took time to assess their field of vision and where their blind spots are.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: What should we do? We'll follow you.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Behemoth.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Listen to them, Levi.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: They beat us.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: It was luck that we were able to transform thanks to the Young Man, but we lost completely.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: We had a clear advantage when it came to specs. And yet we still lost.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: They were more... what did they call it? Tactical, or something.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Heh.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: So I think we should listen to them.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: If we fought them now, we'd win.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: I-I don't think so.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: You guys are exhausted, and um...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: W-we would never lose to a group who fights so haphazardly.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: ... That's a difficult word. I like this one.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... Regardless, I'm grateful that you Heretics have been fighting those things to help us.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: But if you continue to fight like you have, then you're guaranteed to lose.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: And if you lose, those things will head for the Ark. The Ark's forces don't have experience fighting Heretics, so they won't be able to stop them.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: As you pointed out, Leviathan, our weapons right now can't defeat them.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: But you can.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: So how about it? We'll help you if you help us.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Then we can win.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Don't fight like a bunch of hacks trying to beat them with sheer force.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Just this once.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Honestly... you always make everything more difficult...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Hey...!
Eunhwa takes a deep breath.
She looks at the Four Beasts head-on and speaks.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: From now on, I will refer to you each as Beast.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: You're Beast 1.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: You're Beast 2.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Ooh.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: You're Beast 3.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Uh... Huh...?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: You're Beast 4.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: My name is Bahamut. You may also call me the smart one.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: No objections allowed.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: There's something I need to check before we begin.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Is there any risk to you if you repeatedly transform?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Previously, you mentioned that your stamina recovers after you transform.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: That's true. But when we transform again in a short period of time, it... um...

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: It's like the upper limit of our stamina gets cut short again and again.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Ah, so it decreases your maximum stamina. How many times can you do it?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Maybe... two more times?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Good. Now I understand. Compared to the benefits you get, the risk is insignificant.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Beast 1, you team up with Vesti.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Use your ability to control Dark Matter and guide Vesti's missiles to their targets.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: I'll call you the Internal Attack Team.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: I-I look forward to working with you, Beast 1.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Hmm... This feels like it's going in a weird direction.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Beast 2, you're with me.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Use your claws to destroy their shells. I'll guide your aim.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: We'll be the External Attack Team.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Hm, okay. Let's do this, Tactical.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Heh...

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Sh-she really likes hearing that word.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Beast 3, you're with Emma.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Your ability to fly is huge for us. It'll enable Emma to easily adjust how and where she spreads her liquid solution.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: You'll be the Battle Support Team.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Hehe, it's a pleasure to work with you.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Oh, um, yeah.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Beast 4.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Beast 4.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Fine. From now on, I'll be Beast 4.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Your black pillars are flexible and extremely sturdy. When I give the signal, create the toughest, tallest pillars you can.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: As for the diameter...
Eunhwa turns and looks at the Liberalio bodies spewing water at random.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: They should be about ten meters across. Can you do that?

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Ten meters... so a hundred centimeters.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... It's a thousand.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Ah, of course. I, the brilliant Beast 4, was momentarily confused.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... Don't do anything at all until I give you the signal.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: You're our secret weapon, so we want to keep you hidden.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: I understand. I, Beast 4, am the secret weapon.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: How will you give me the signal?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: You'll feel like you were just hit by a flash to the head. Do it then.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: I, the insightful Beast 4, am always getting hit by flashes of insight.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... I guarantee this one will feel a bit different. Do it then.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: A new sensation for my keen self? I look forward to it.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: All right. Let's begin.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: It's odd. I can't tell why Eunhwa looks so happy.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: She said we'd find out once we got here, but I still have no idea.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Vesti, do you know?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Hehe, I think I do.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Right now...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Eunhwa is having fun using those monsters as her subordinates.
